criteria.title: Browser discovery normalizes bahia-contextvm-v1
criteria.assertion: Trusted service-authored NIP-51 relay set events tagged d=bahia-contextvm-v1 are normalized into nostr.contextvm_relays and retained in _discovery.relay_sets.

criteria.title: Missing ContextVM relay set falls back with degraded metadata
criteria.assertion: When bahia-contextvm-v1 is absent, nostr.contextvm_relays falls back to nostr.browser_relays and exposes contextvm_relay_metadata.degraded=true with a missing-contextvm reason.

criteria.title: Encrypted capability gating remains separate
criteria.assertion: ContextVM relay discovery does not enable encrypted ContextVM requests unless features.encrypted_nostr_requests, service_pubkey, and relay availability are all present.

criteria.title: Discovery lifecycle remains event driven
criteria.assertion: The browser discovery query uses scoped filters and deterministic EVENT/EOSE/CLOSED handling, including auth-required CLOSED failure, without polling or sleep-based completion.
